# Ghost Ops — Strategic Roadmap (Q2 – Q4 2026)

> **SSOT Owner:** Lead LLM Architect | **Last Updated:** 2026-04-22 | **Version:** 0.5.1  
> **State File:** `/docs/.system_state` | **Standards Ref:** `/docs/STANDARDS.md`

---

## North Star

**Zero-Human Operations (ZHO).** The system patches, optimizes, and evolves itself. Source code is ephemeral—generated by AI intent, compiled to WASM, executed in a sandbox, and discarded when a better version is synthesized.

---

## Phases at a Glance

| Phase | Period | Theme | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| PHASE-2 | Q2 2026 (Apr–Jun) | Scale & Distribution | 95% test · 0 lint · O(n) |
| PHASE-3a | Q3 2026 (Jul–Sep) | Multi-Language Autonomy | EU AI Act compliant |
| PHASE-3b | Q4 2026 (Oct–Dec) | Full ZHO | ISO/IEC 42001 audit pass |

## Logic Gates (Engine Assignment)

```
IF task.risk == HIGH OR task.context_size > 8k_tokens
  → Assign: Claude Pro

IF task.type IN [snippet, refactor, boilerplate, test]
  → Assign: Jules | Antigravity | GitHub Copilot

IF standards.age > 30 days
  → [SYNC] external reference check (ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act portal)
```
